items.text: Patch 1.05 was released earlier today on all platforms.
Fixed an issue where specific trophies could not be unlocked ("Completed body", "Completed firearm" and "Completed grave").
Hello Gunslingers,
Our Patch Notes 1.04 are ready!
Polished 8 direction moving animation
Fixed value of blending and speed of montage & blend space
Animation added to a gem of the clothes
Fixed an issue that animation being awkward by instantaneous operation
Fixed an issue that animation stuttering when operation is done while shooting

Bunji: Fixed an issue that a bullet flying awkwardly when jumped while on Full Auto Mode

For more info, exclusivities and updates, you can also follow Gungrave G.O.R.E on Twitter!

items.text: Gunslingers,
Here's the Patch Notes 1.01, bringing new content and minor bug fixes along with a free "Cel-Shaded Mode"!
Cel-Shaded Mode added
Idle Motion added (If you stay as idle for more than 10 seconds, one out of three animations will play randomly)
Invincible while using demolition shot
Fixed issue of Burst mode being activated when FULL AUTO mode is activated and holding R2 while using Blood Cannon
Fixed issue of Bunji activating Burst Mode when FULL AUTO mode is activated and holding R2 while using Shoot Up
Fixed issue of Bunji being able to use Demolition Shots while grabbing an enemy
Fixed issue of Death Spear not being activated when player used dodge roll more than twice while charging
Fixed issue of AUTO FIRE function not working when the played save file is from before the Day One version
Fixed issue of NPCs still moving before Graveyard is fully activated in certain situations
Fixed issue of Ballad Bird Lee and Bear Walken AI stopping when a Demolition Shot is used
Fixed issue of Ganpo's attack not giving any damage to Grave when standing on certain area
Fixed icon shown in Windows Task bar as defult icon of Unreal Engine.
Experimental Cave level's changed jump platform level design is not implemented on map select image
Grave not getting hit by Ganpro Superior when he used certain attack and camera is looking at the same direction as Ganpo
Fixed issue of thrown enemies moving while using Demolition Shots
Grave teleporting to somewhere when getting out of Ganpo Superior's Grab attack
Polished animation of Ganpo Superior
Fixed an issue where the death sentence looked like it is dragged out
Grave's melee attack will not cancel it's own animaiton anymore
Improved Demolition Shot's damage
Demolition gauge gains more per shot
Improved Graved Yard
Demolition Shots' production added – Doom’s Rain, Death Drive, and Executioner’s Blood
Improved hit detection of Funeral Strke
Improved Parring detection so it is easier to parry those projectiles
Adjusted balance of the game
Changed HP and damage of enemies in Easy and Normal difficulty
Attack motion changed for Ligabu
Fixed animation of Bhrbau
Who-Knows-Who's floor explotingm attack will be smaller
Ganpo Standard’s attacking range has been polished
When Ganpo Superior gets into phase 2, his 3-way laser attack motion has been fixed
Blending has been done for Ganpo Superior’s animation
For Quartz, her demolition point increased by 1
When you restart or continue at the map you previously played, the earned demolition points stay still
Added delay and effect when Ligabu, Zell Condorbrave, and Brhbau prepare to attack
Made getting out of stun easier against bosses(you will have to shake stick left and right much less now)
Crosshair now appears when hell hound or hell fire is being used
Destructible objects have been added to Infected Sewers, Grave’s Base, and Harbinger’s Pit
Polishing Autofire HUD UI
Added Autofire UI save system(Maintaining last selected option)
Polished Demolition Shot video in Lab
Jump Storm Barrage can break shields now
Death Tornado’s tutorial explanation has been added
Added effect for Ligabu's Leaping attack
You can also find us on Twitter and check our website!
Hello Gunslingers,
Our Patch Notes 1.0 are ready!

PC: Pressing while playing the game will toggle Normal/FULL AUTO mode. When using FULL AUTO mode, you cannot use Death Spear, But if you toggle back to Normal mode, you can use Death Spear again. Use whatever mode when the situation requires you to use it.
Activates Burst mode when using FULL AUTO while standing still
Added parring and missile reflection in Funeral Strike
Added shield-breaking function in Executioner’s Blood
When Grave/Bunji/Quartz knocks down, they'll stay invulnerable for a while.
Fixed an issue where Bunji is not getting Art Score when executing an enemy
Fixed an issue where the controller kept vibrating when the player uses Death Spear after holding the trigger button while using jump shot
Fixed an issue where a stage was not cleared when the player reaches the stage clear point without killing all the enemies
Fixed an issue where charging turns off when the player passes through certain areas while charging, in Hong Kong Rooftop level
Fixed an issue of Who Knows Who's spawning indication appearing in the wrong location
Fixed an issue where Who Know Who's ending cutscene was not played
Fixed an issue of Grave not dying when hit by a tunnel while holding any enemies. He will die after getting crashed by a tunnel whether he grabs an enemy or not.
Fixed an issue of Grave getting stuck on a map object after getting caught by Brhatu
Fixed an issue where Brandon Heat/Bunji's firing speed slows down while playing the game
Fixed an issue where the controller’s vibration was not working when Who Knows Who shoots projectiles
Fixed a progression issue in the Ship’s Core level (Scumland) center being blocked due to certain enemies standing still
Fixed an issue of shield damage not showing properly when getting hit by certain skills after the boss battle in the Harbinger’s Pit level (Scumland Center)
Fixed an issue of the Secret Laboratory level (Vietnam) boss not attacking Grave when the player is standing still in a certain area
Fixed an issue of the Infected Sewer level boss getting stuck on the wall when standing too close to it
Fixed an issue of boss tooltips not showing up after the player dies and restart while having a boss battle
Fixed an issue of shadows not appearing properly in the Skyline level
Fixed holes and floating objects in certain levels
Fixed issue when Grave falls out of the train after getting hit by the mine and get stuck on a block instead of dying.
Demolition shots are now able to break shields
Enhanced Grab Smash now gives knockback to enemies 360 degrees around
Attack damage increased when playing as Bunji/Quartz in Hard difficulty
Close combat damage increased when playing as Bunji/Quartz in Hard difficulty
Grave/Bunji's Burst mode damage increased
Grave's close combat will not cut off when hit by enemies while using it
Storm Barrage will not cut off when hit by enemies while the player has a shield left
Increased Grave/Bunji's movement speed while shooting
Shield of Shielded enemy has less HP so it will break easier in close combat
Laser-shooting enemies will shoot their laser less due to the 2-second delay in-between
Missile-shooting enemies will not shoot another missile until their previous missile is blown up
Level design of the Freight Train/Experiment Cave has been improved
Made deadly pits of Hong Kong Back Alley levels darker so they look more dangerous to fall off
Damage of Laser in Laser Area at Turonty HQ level has decreased majorly.
Tutorial on FULL AUTO has been added / Tutorial appearing area and description have been fixed
Pop-ups on FULL AUTO have been added
Mafias' voice-over will be more diverse. (English/Korean)
The options menu has been fixed for the Auto Target toggle
UI for Brandon Heat has been added.
